title: Extending principal-open sections on a qcqs open after a power
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent], and $W\subseteq X$ a quasi-compact, quasi-separated open. Here quasi-separated means that intersections of quasi-compact opens contained in $W$ are quasi-compact. Let $a\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_X)$ and $s\in\Gamma(D_W(a),\mathcal F)$, where $D_W(a)$ is the open locus on which the germ of $a$ is invertible. There are $n\geq0$ and $t\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal F)$ with $t|_{D_W(a)}=(a|_{D_W(a)})^n s$.

source.place: Tag 01LC, proof; original proof steps 1-3, surjectivity of principal localization via finite affine covers and overlap gluing

proof.text: Choose a finite affine cover U_i of W. Put b_i=a|U_i and D_i=D_W(a) cap U_i=D(b_i). The affine localization results give n_i and t_i on U_i with t_i|D_i=b_i^n_i s|D_i. Take N=max_i n_i and v_i=b_i^(N-n_i)t_i, so v_i|D_i=a^N s|D_i. This uses the existing exists_map_eq_pow_smul_of_isAffineOpen and functoriality of restriction.

Quasi-separatedness of W makes each U_i cap U_j quasi-compact. On that overlap let c_ij=a|overlap and d_ij=v_i|overlap-v_j|overlap. Both v_i and v_j restrict to a^N s on overlap cap D_W(a), hence d_ij vanishes on D(c_ij). Apply the compact-open power-torsion theorem to obtain k_ij with c_ij^k_ij d_ij=0. The quasi-separatedness hypothesis is the compact-intersection condition used directly in Lean.

Take K=max_(i,j) k_ij. The local sections z_i=b_i^K v_i agree on every overlap, since c_ij^K d_ij=0. Glue them to z on W by the sheaf axiom. On every D_i the restriction of z is a^(K+N)s; these D_i cover D_W(a), so uniqueness gives z|D_W(a)=a^(K+N)s. The finite maxima and sheaf uniqueness also cover empty W and empty principal opens.

proof_origin.place: elementwise form of finite affine gluing and localization

theorem exists_map_eq_pow_smul_of_isCompact_of_isQuasiSeparated
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (hqs : IsQuasiSeparated (W : Set X))
    (a : Γ(X, W)) (s₀ : Γ(F, X.basicOpen a)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(F, W)),
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le a)).op t =
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le a)).op a ^ n • s₀
